caseName: Consolidated Gas Electric Light & Power Co. v. Pennsylvania Water & Power Co.
caseNameFull: Consolidated Gas Electric Light & Power Co. of Baltimore v. Pennsylvania Water & Power Co. and Public Service Commission of Maryland v. Pennsylvania Water & Power Co.
attorneys: Harry N. Baetjer, Alfred P. Ramsey, G. Kenneth Reiblich and John Henry Lewin for petitioner in No. 611. Charles D. Harris for petitioner in No. 612. William J. Grove and Thomas M.
